name: AFK Tag
summary: See at a glance who is away from the keyboard: idle players get a grey AFK mark in front of their name in the player list.
logoPrompt: A glowing hourglass with grey sand running through it, standing on a stone block, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Know who is away from the keyboard.
bullets: Chat line when they go and return

description: **AFK Tag marks players who have stopped playing for a while, so everyone on the server knows at a glance who is really there.**
- After 5 idle minutes a grey `[AFK]` appears in front of the player's name in the player list.
- The chat says when someone goes AFK and when they are back.
- Walking, looking around, chatting, commands and any click clear the tag at once.
- Drifting in water, riding without steering or being teleported does not count as being active.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API and start the server. Hold the Tab key to see the player list. To change the idle time, edit `minutes` in `config/afktag.json` and restart.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything. It also works in singleplayer and on LAN.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
